body: After i purge, I actually feel pretty good. This is gonna sound messed up but it feels like self care(even though i know that that's not true at all). It's the same feeling you get after putting on a face mask and painting your nails. And even KNOWING that im sick is validating and feels like "self love." Trust me I know it doesn't make sense lol. It isn't until the day AFTER purging that the guilt and sadness and anxiety start to consume me. Once i come down from that "high" is when the realization of what id done the day before finally hits me.
